item.title: Ba edge Nadi 1-0 in BOG opener
Taveuni Rugby team receives major boost from diaspora in America
item.description: Taveuni Rugby received a much-needed boost to their Skipper Cup campaign following the donation of more than $14,000 from the Fijian diaspora living in the United States. The total donation of $14,698.49 reflects the continued commitment of Fijians living abroad in supporting grassroots rugby.
item.content:encoded:
Taveuni Rugby received a much-needed boost to their Skipper Cup campaign following the donation of more than $14,000 from the Fijian diaspora living in the United States.

The total donation of $14,698.49 reflects the continued commitment of Fijians living abroad in supporting grassroots rugby.

The Taveuni Management says $12,698.49 was allocated to player allowances last night , helping the squad with their final preparations ahead of tomorrow’s crucial clash.

They say the support has gone far beyond financial contributions and the Taveuni community in America has stepped in at critical moment throughout the team’s journey away from home, including assistance with transportation costs.

The management says their contributions have included transportation for DiMila’s reguregu and Qasina Loa in Naduri, as well as transport from Lautoka to Suva, with a total of $2,000 committed towards transportation.

Taveuni is expecting a physical encounter when they take on Naitasiri at 3pm tomorrow at Ratu Cakobau Park in Nausori.

In other matches, Tailevu will take on Rewa at Nakelo District School Ground, while Nadi faces Navosa at King Charles Park.

In Lautoka, the home side will meet Malolo, while Nadroga takes on Ba at Lawaqa Park.

item.title: Taveuni Rugby Union secures Merchant Finance sponsorship for remaining Skipper Cup games
item.description: The Taveuni Rugby Union will now benefit from Merchant Finance Limited’s sponsorship as its Official Naming Rights Partner for its remaining five home games in the 2026 Skipper Cup competition. Th e partnership reflects Merchant Finance’s commitment to supporting community development and grassroots sport while strengthening its presence in Taveuni, where the company has a branch.
item.content:encoded:
The Taveuni Rugby Union will now benefit from Merchant Finance Limited’s sponsorship as its Official Naming Rights Partner for its remaining five home games in the 2026 Skipper Cup competition.

Th e partnership reflects Merchant Finance’s commitment to supporting community development and grassroots sport while strengthening its presence in Taveuni, where the company has a branch.

Under the partnership, Merchant Finance will provide support to assist the union in hosting its remaining home fixtures and supporting player participation throughout the season.

Merchant Finance Limited Chief Executive Officer Veilawa Rereiwasaliwa says the sponsorship reflects the company’s commitment to supporting communities across the North.

Taveuni Rugby Union Vice President Iowane Gade says the sponsorship will make a significant contribution towards the successful completion of their 2026 campaign.

As the Naming Rights Partner, Merchant Finance will receive brand visibility across match-day activities, community engagement initiatives, promotional platforms and other agreed sponsorship benefits during the remaining home fixtures.

The partnership also aims to support community development, youth engagement and the growth of rugby in Taveuni, while creating opportunities for Merchant Finance to connect with the wider community.

Meanwhile, Taveuni faces Naitasiri at Ratu Cakobau Park tomorrow.

In other matches, Tailevu will take on Rewa at Nakelo District School Ground, Nadi faces Navosa at King Charles Park, and Suva meet Kadavu in Nasese, Suva.

In Lautoka, the home side will meet Malolo, while Nadroga takes on Ba at Lawaqa Park.

All games is set to start at 3pm tomorrow.

item.title: Sisters Naisewa and Marawa to lead Fijiana forwards against Japan
item.description: Sisters Karalaini Naisewa and Keleni Marawa will lead the forwards upfront with Karalaini at prop and Marama at hooker for the Vodafone Fijiana team against Japan tonight. Tiana Robanakadavu will complete the front row at tighthead.
item.content:encoded:
Sisters Karalaini Naisewa and Keleni Marawa will lead the forwards upfront with Karalaini at prop and Marama at hooker for the Vodafone Fijiana team against Japan tonight.

Tiana Robanakadavu will complete the front row at tighthead.

Power and impact will also come from the bench, with the formidable Bitila Tawake ready to make her mark when called upon.

The versatile Merewairita Neivoha , usually deployed on the wing or at centre, starts at openside flanker after previously featuring in the position against South Africa.

At the back, Ivamere Rokowati takes on the responsibility of the final line of defence.

The backline combines strength, balance and pace, with Josivini Neihamu and Ruth Raketekete set to control the midfield, while Aqela Raitubu and Atelaite Ralivanawa provide speed and finishing power out wide.

There is plenty of energy waiting on the bench, with young Carletta Yee joined by Salote Nailolo and Repeka Tove .

The side will be led by captain Kolora Lomani , while vice-captain Alfreda Fisher anchors the pack at number eight, providing control and composure at the back of the scrum.

The Fijiana will face Japan at 8pm tonight.
